Babur the Tightfist

Biography

Babur the Tightfist is the village craftsman. The theft of his favourite tools leaves him unable to work, and their recovery wins Zak access to his services. He distrusts Erfar’s “Free Hunters”, bargains fiercely and knows much about the surrounding ruins. His advice about the Magic Bit, the drawbridge mechanism and Estera’s trap key helps Zak reach the witch. [1, 2, 3, 4]
